steps.content: The emergency lights flicker and buzz overhead. You race through the corridor, footsteps hammering a frantic rhythm against the metal floor.
But soon, you feel your steps grow sluggish.
What starts as a faint tug quickly becomes a struggle, as if you're trudging through a heavy marsh. Every step requires tremendous effort.
The thick, damp air is mixed with a faint, foul odor that invades your lungs with every quickening breath.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Ugh, that smell...
Drip.

Something wet and sticky drips from the ceiling onto your head, mingling with the sweat on your forehead as it trickles down to your brow. The stench hits you full force: the reek of rotting fish, concentrated several times over.
Someone steadies you just in time and wipes the filth from your forehead with a sleeve. You look up into Shin's concerned eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's left by a crawling deep-sea creature. Something's already gotten inside the ship.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Sure. The comms signal... it's gone.
You both know what that means, but neither of you says a word. You simply quicken your steps in tacit understanding. Squelching footsteps echo eerily in the corridor, leaving a trail of pale ooze.
[Scene Transition: Still in corridor]
The door of the wheelhouse is spattered with sticky globs of gunk. Caught in the slime are the shredded bits of a uniform, smeared with dark, wet blood.
Thud, thud-thud, thud. An irregular pounding comes from behind the half-open door.
Shin catches your eye and raises a finger to her lips. Stay quiet. Shielding you with her body, she grasps the handle and slowly pushes the door open.
[Black Screen Horizontal Wipe]

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Mmph—help... help!
[Show Wheelhouse]

Captain Edmond is half-collapsed beside the console, his upper body strangled by a gelatinous creature. Thick slime smothers his mouth and nose as he desperately swings a wrench, trying to knock away the writhing mass gripping his face.
On the other side, Vikmar is slumped over, his helmet cracked. A shattered comms device lies in pieces near his hand.
Shin immediately understands. She moves to Vikmar's side to ensure he's safe from further harm.
You rush to the captain, grab the wrench from his hand, and bring it down hard on the mass crushing his chest.

The mass convulses, and a thick, tar-like substance spurts from the gash. Seizing the moment it loosens its grip, you grit your teeth and yank the thing off the captain's face, flinging it against the wall.
Shin immediately understands. She moves to the captain's side as you approach Vikmar.
She grabs the wrench from his hand and brings it down on the mass crushing his chest.
The mass convulses, and a thick, tar-like substance spurts from the gash. Seizing the moment it loosens its grip, she yanks the thing off the captain's face and flings it against the wall.
It splats into an indescribable pulp and slides down the wall, before lying still in a puddle of its own ooze.
The captain, breathing freely again, scrambles back to the helm. Vikmar has also come around.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: Thank goodness you're here, Shin...
He starts to thank her, but the relieved sigh on his lips suddenly morphs into a gasp of horror.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: I-it.. it's...!
The puddle of flesh on the ground is twitching. Tiny lumps bulge from its surface, pulsing like a heart. In the center of the mass, a new maw is taking shape.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: You've got to be kidding me!

With a roar, Captain Edmond lunges at the unholy creature, trying to pin it down with his weight. But the monster, revived with greater strength, hurls him across the room into the console. Then, slick with its own ooze, it charges straight at you.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: —Watch out!
Shin throws herself in front of you without a second thought, raising her arm as the monster opens its gaping maw.
That brief moment is enough. The creature visibly falters; the next second, Captain Edmond is on it, bringing the wrench down on its head.
Splat.
The second blow smashes it to pieces. It twitches twice, then melts away into a puddle of black ichor.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Phew... Are you alright?!

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I'm fine. How about you? Are you okay?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine. Thank you, Shin. I...
As you stare at the puddle on the ground, a dull ringing fills your ears.
[Contamination Effect]
Waiting... waiting for you...
[Red Flash]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What was that...
Captain Edmond has returned to the console, his expression grave. Vikmar crouches nearby, carefully wiping the slime from the panels to prevent it from fouling the main systems again.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: T-they're really trying to stop us from leaving, aren't they...?

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Don’t overthink. There's no proof that they're that smart. One just happened to slip in and cause some trouble. We'll fix the equipment. Things will be alright.
Shin calmly walks over to the console and examines the flickering navigation readings. Her dress is soiled by the ooze, but she offers her handkerchief to the captain first.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You should wipe your face, Captain. The comms are jammed, so you'll have to brief the crew in person. They'll be unsettled to see you like this.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: ...The news itself is enough to cause panic.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Which is why we need you, Captain. Immediately notify the crew: every hatch, entrance, and exit must be guarded by at least one armed crew member at max alert. Tell Pylgia to reduce her dive radius and be ready to return to shore at any time.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Right. Leave it to me.
The captain cleans his face, straightens his clothes, and strides out of the room.
You look at Vikmar. Terror is still written all over his face. At the sound of Shin's voice, the big man shudders.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't worry, we'll make it back safely.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The anemometer shows the wind speed dropping in the southwest, and the barometer readings are low. This combination usually means a local cyclone or some other disturbance ahead.
She lightly taps several flashing indicators on the screen, then glances at the humidity readings.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Humidity's still rising; sea foam's dense on the surface. There's a strong upwelling, probably from a sudden change in terrain... or large creature activity. Either way, we avoid areas with abnormal wind speeds or intense surface glare, and follow the sea lanes with stable pressure and sparse foam. Not so hard, right?
Vikmar stares intently at the numbers, his fear slowly giving way to focus.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: The captain is out there to give hope and confidence. I am here to read the signs of the sea. As for steering the ship... can I entrust that to you?
Vikmar stares at Shin's hands. These hands, used to flipping through research papers, had just fought a vicious battle. Now, with these reassuring hands, she's entrusting him with the helm.
He thinks for a moment, then nods firmly.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: I... I can't promise I won't make any mistakes, but I'll give it my all.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't worry. As long as we're at sea, there are innumerable ways to reach our destination. Instruments are just aids. What matters most is experience, and...
Shin walks over to you and gently pats you on the back.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Sharp eyes.
